title: Garnet & Golden
description: This mod adds a lot of stuff that branch from Pink Garnet and Golden Leaf
body:
Welcome to my first mod Garnet & Golden, this mode was created more as a learning tool so there will be a lot of random stuff but I will try to keep it related to it.
I am useing [Kaupenjoe's tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oU8-qV-ZtUY&list=PLKGarocXCE1H_HxOYihQMq0mlpqiUJj4L&index=2) for the Garnet and the Golden part is me trying to use the newly learned stuff to create my own stuff.

## Mod curently contains:
- **Pink Garnet** (item)
- **Pink Garnet Block** (block)
- **Raw Pink Garnet** (Item)
- **Raw Pink Garnet Block** (block)
- **Pink Garnet Ore** (block)
- **Pink Garnet Deepslate Ore** (block)
- **Golden Leaf** (item)
- **Golden Leaf Block** (block)
- **Golden Leaf Bricks** (block)

> note that I will try to balance out Garnet and Golden features in the future.

### Source Code
The sorce code can be found on my [GitHub](https://github.com/ARandomModder/MyFirstMod-1.21-Garnet-Golden).

There will be more updated on the GitHub but I will post all the major updates on Modrinth :P
